_about: What a match side reads as when its competition hides names. Read by maskView.sideReading (public_names_side_cases_test.go) and by the court bridge's mask (web-mobile/js/__tests__/court_bridge_side_cases.test.jsx): the operator tab's copy of the mask and the server's judge the same cases. A competitor reads as its number, "?" when it has none or when the side names someone the roster does not hold; only an empty side and the draw's placeholders stay as written. A side carrying a name and no id is not in this table: the server resolves it from the draw before it reaches the mask, while the browser may still find it by its unique roster name.

cases.name: a numbered competitor reads as the number
a competitor the draw has not numbered reads ?
an id the roster does not hold reads ?
a name no roster entry holds, with no id, reads ?
an empty side (a bye) stays empty
a winner-of feeder stays as written
a pool finalist placeholder stays as written
a doubled-letter pool placeholder stays as written
a name that only starts like a placeholder reads ?
